[Spoiler=context]
The Capricorn Archipelago (or Capricornia) is an archipelago south of the Vespuries, most of the islands are under the control of the Republic of Capricornia, however there is a small portion, the island of Sebastião de Souto, which is controlled by Bravanor. The islands were colonized by Gendarme during the colonial period, with the exception of Sebastião which was discovered by the explorer Diogo Rezende and named in honor of Saint Saint Sebastian, originally transformed into an island fortress for prisoners, much of the island was later conquered by Gendarme, except for the small portion of the island that remained under control even after the independence of Bravanor.

Currently the Capricornian Republic is governed by President Maximilien Bachelot, and its armed forces are entirely focused on defense and maritime patrol.

[/SPOILER]
[SpoILer=Conquest of Capricorn-Declaration of War and beginning]
[b]May 2010[/b]
[i]Commander Lucas Marques on the line, we are prepared to attack, at your command, sir minister, we will attack.[/i]
[i]Permission granted.[/i]
The imperial minister Floriano Juliano responded, and soon after disconnected the communication, Colonel Marques then ordered:
[i]PREPARE ARTILLERY.[/i]
He waited for his soldiers for a few moments to prepare the howitzers, he then thought:
[i]This will change the entire course of the history of this archipelago, losing would be humiliating, winning will allow us to gain more resources and thus expand our military....[/i]
Marques pointed his finger to the horizon, and ordered:
[i][b]FIRE[/b]![/i]
And so it was, the howitzers fired, hitting the city of Plairault, the Capricorn minister stationed on the island on vacation with his family, Defense Minister Jean Fournier, quickly picked up the nearby radio and communicated with the capital island.
[i]Plairault to Bouves, President, we have just received an artillery salvo from...[/i]
[i]Mister Minister, our radars have detected an even larger Bravanorian fleet approaching the republic.[/i]
[i]Mon Dieu[/i].
He muttered in shock, then resumed reporting:
[i]Bravanor has openly declared war on the republic, I ask permission from the President...[/i]
[i]I grant you such permission, Minister Fournier, defend our islands tooth and nail.[/i]
[i]Understood[/i].
He answered and then hung up, left his vacation home and then went outside to call a helicopter for his family, he called them:
[i]LET'S GO, Rachel, Sara, Henri, our land is under attack.[/i]
-------------------------------------------------------------------------
In the Capricorn Sea.
[i]Ohoho, look at that, Plairault...it looks so defenseless.[/i]
Vice Admiral Miguel Soares spoke, while near the bow of the White Swan cruiser, the main one of its class, the fleet behind him contained about 12 other vessels, in the sky a total of 6 C14 Harpia aircraft escorted the fleet.
[i]Commander Soares, we have detected an anomaly in the radars.[/i]
The captain of the ship, Luís de Souto, approached the vice admiral, asking for permission to speak. Soares replied:
[i]Well then, tell me.[/i]
[i]Apparently, sir, there is a small light Capricorn fleet approaching from the east. Apparently, there are three frigates, all of the Kersaint class.[/i]
[i]The Kersaint class ships are stealth frigates, skilled at maintaining stealth even on the high seas. How could they be detected so easily?[/i]
Soares thought to himself and then replied.
[i]Leave them alone. They must be assigned to patrol missions. There is no reason to attack unless they attack us first.[/i]
Soares stated, as he dismissed the captain, returning to observe the sea.

[/sPoiLEr]
[Spoiler=The war itself]
On May 7th, a mere day after the first attack that started the war, Colonel Marques gave a speech to instill morale in the soldiers
[i]We must attack, since yesterday we have bombarded the enemy with artillery, today we will advance, Vice Admiral Soares must have already made his plans for the attack, under my command, we will advance through the forest to the enemy positions.[/i]
The soldiers responded with a salute to the colonel, who smiled with pride at his troops, he cut the air with his hand and shouted:
[i][b]HAILI EMPIRE!!![/b][/i]
-
As he climbed into a transport helicopter alongside his Fournier family, his older sister, Marie Fournier was the only one who would remain in Plairault, of her own free will, he tasked her with being regent governor of the island while Jean was away:
[i]Your mission will be to ensure that Plairault must not fall into enemy hands until I return, understood?[/i]
Jean said to his sister, focused on her while keeping his hands on an AR-Capricornia rifle (essentially an AR-15), finally, the helicopter took off, then Jean picked up a radio to give orders to the units on the island:
[i]The units stationed in Plairault, this is Minister Jean Fournier speaking, we will not be able to win from Bravanor in a direct conflict, because r that's it, prepare guerrilla warfare and surprise attacks, the objective is to gain time until I can find a way to counterattack and expel the invaders from our islands.[/i]
Jean communicated to the units on the island.
-
[b]São José-intelligence center.[/b]
[i]Based on the fact that their minister had left Plairault, he certainly already communicated to the president and his troops, hmm...[/i]
Director Gaspar Reis analyzed the tactical map of the battlefield, sitting in his office chair, adjusting his impeccable suit. [i]Intelligence will be essential if we want to win against an enemy that knows it cannot win directly and will resort to guerrilla tactics, as one might imagine, should alert Colonel Marques, but he knows what he is doing and therefore must know that the enemy will be using guerrilla tactics.[/i]
Gaspar took a sip of his coffee before pointing to the sea of ​​the islands:
[i]Strait of Capricorn, the Capricornian navy has as its capital ship a...cruiser, similar to the Empire, however the Capricornian fleet is...inefficient, its ships are fast stealths, invisible to many radars, but useless in combat with their light armament, final verdict, if the war continues as it is, the chances of defeat are, at worst, minimal...Now I need to pass this on to the reports and to the commanders at the front. [/i]
[i]Oh, final detail...[/i]
Reis remembered as he returned to the report and finished typing:
[b][i]Hail Empire.[/i][/b]
----
[i]Hello, Minister Fournier?[/i]
The president's voice sounded through Jean's phone, he answered and replied:
[i]I'm here, Mr. President, we're on our way to Bouves right now.[/i]
[i]Understood, Fournier, I grant you permission to appoint one of your officers to command all armed forces currently in conflict, use this power well.[/i]
[i]I will do so, sir.[/i]
Jean answered before hanging up, then called one of his officers, Admiral Thibault Bechart. [i]Admiral Bechart, I know you are currently in St. Louis, BUT, I am assigning you the mission of becoming commander of the army, navy and air force of the republic, all of our... 3,000 soldiers, 12 aircraft and 15 ships are under your command, use them wisely, your position in St. Louis allows you to operate the armed forces more appropriately[/i]. ---
The Bauru B1000 drone was flying over the forest, with a wide view from above. The drone captain, Filiberto Santana, who was watching his officers operating the Tactical Drone, warned the colonel:
[i]Colonel, it seems that the Capricorns are in ideal positions for guerrilla warfare. I suggest we advance with caution.[/i]
In response, Marques said:
"You're right, and I know it, my soldiers too... wouldn't that be... [i]The basics?"[/i]
-------
[b][i]FOR CAPRICORN![/i][/b]
A small group of soldiers appeared, firing their Capricorn ARs, firing at a Bravanorean platoon. The lieutenant ordered:
[i]Keep calm and counterattack![/i]
[i] VIVE LE CAPRICORNE, ESCORIES! [/i]
One of the Capricorn soldiers shouted as he fired fiercely, in response a Bravanorian infantryman shot him with his IMBEL A99, the bullet went through the soldier's skull who fell inert to the ground.
[i]Shut up.[/i]
The soldier said, as soon as they appeared, the Capricorns retreated again.
[i]They fled, cowards.[/i]
The lieutenant said, as he checked if the soldiers were okay, they all survived, although 2-3 had superficial injuries, they said it was nothing and kept advancing.
.
[b]WhiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiiZ BOOOM[/b]
[b]Boooooom[/b] [b]Booom[/b]
The explosions continued in the forest launched by 60mm mortars, the guerrillas ran from their positions as they were blown up by the Bravanorian fire. -
[i]Thank you very much, Captain Filiberto Santana, for the information about the drones. With this information, the war will be much easier....[/i]
Soares thanked Santana for the images provided by the drones.
[i]Thank you again, Captain. This information will be crucial for the good of the Empire. Long live the Emperor. [b]HAPPEN EMPIRE[/b]
[/i]The transmission has ended.
With the prior permission of the other subordinate commanders of the fleet, the Vice Admiral opened a radar map of the region. The photos and information were blocked in a region of the island. The local barracks and ammunition depots were located.
[b]TARGET DEFINED, CITY OF Plairault[/b]
The button was pressed, and a total of 15 missiles were launched. The Vice Admiral looked at the missiles, saluting as they left the cylinders and projected outwards, and spoke.
[b]AVE EMPIRE[/b]
[i]MSSI missiles, these will work for sure, in fact, they are beautiful weapons...[/i]
Soares thought to himself.
-
[i]Mon Dieu...[/i]
[i]What is it Louis (intelligence chief)[/i]
Marie asked, Louis just showed her, the radars detected Bravanorean missiles coming towards the city, she turned pale, trembling she spoke softly:
[i]...They, they are really...PREPARE THE DEFENSES![/i]
She ordered, and Then he went to Colonel Charles Dupont and ordered the defenses to be prepared immediately, but the delay prevented them from being mobilized correctly, 75% of the missiles hit the target, 15% missed their targets and 10% were intercepted, Admiral Bechart made his first announcement since the beginning of the war:
[i]This morning, these filthy invaders flooded our land with missiles, this is unacceptable, they destroyed families, animals, such an atrocity has never been seen since the independence of Capricornia, I Admiral Bechart promise revenge on my part for the 9 lives lost in this attack against humanity.[/i]
------------
[i]What are they doing, they were not supposed to attack urban centers, ugh, I see that Arion (Minister of Foreign Affairs) and I will have to ease up on this later... This does not sound good especially for a member of the Big Six, if Soares continues like this we will have to take drastic measures against him and his supervisors...[/i]
Director Gaspar looked at the monitor in confusion as it showed the damage to military installations and also some urban areas...
[i]I'm already putting together Arion's speech to help him with that, and probably my own in the meantime... I hate my job but I'm the only one who does it well in this country.[/i]
Reis grumbled as he turned back to his computer.
--------
[i]PPF.[/i]
An intelligence officer asked Colonel Marques, who looked at him and responded by raising his hand with a yes gesture.
[i]Permission granted.[/i]
[i]We detected two Capricorn helicopters in Plairault.[/i]
Marques sighed and said in response:
[i]Tell the officers not to worry that we will send MANPADS to them immediately without delay.[/i]
[i]Understood sir.[/i]
He responded by leaving without delay. Marques looked at the horizon towards the forest, thinking:
[i]If we conquer the island before the end of the month, we will be free to conquer everything else... we should hurry things up, but we have to analyze the progress well before taking any further measures...[/i]
----
[b]Twoooooosh[/b].
The sound of the waves hitting the hulls of the ships echoed, while he was in his cabin next to Captain Souto, Soares detected unusual movement on the radars, they were jets and ships, apparently light frigates.
[i]Ugh, these things are coming to delay us, Kersaints, tell the pilots to deal with these frigates so they don't delay our advance.[/i]
[i]Yes sir.[/i]
The captain replied.
[i]In the meantime, you[/i].
He pointed to the ship's vice captain. [i]Prepare the cannons in case they think about getting too close.[/i]
The vice captain agreed and went out to warn the sailors.
[i]Hmm...there are also two destroyers and 5 frigates, something miserable honestly...but anyway...[/i]
Soares pressed the meeting button, to his surprise the captains of the other ships in the fleet were already waiting for him, he warned them:
[i]Capricorns close by, 2 destroyers and 5 frigates, an apparently suicidal attack, but you never know...[/i]
-
[b]Air and naval combat.[/b]
[i]Advancing towards the Capricorn vessels, launching anti-ship missiles in 1....2....3[/i]
The pilot José Fernandes announced on the radio, as he pressed a button, a missile came out of the wing and aimed at the Kersaint Frigate, the largest although less armed. [i]THEY ARE ATTACKING US![/i]
Vice Admiral Maximilien Dupont, in charge of the central fleet, announced over the radio to Admiral Bechart.
[i]We are being attacked by Bravanorean missiles, our defense systems intercepted them, but...[/i]
He took a deep breath before continuing.
[I]Forgive us, Admiral, but our sneak attack failed.[/i]
[i]What?! You don't stand a chance against their main fleet in the archipelago, retreat before they close in on you![/i]
Bechart ordered, a certain desperation in his voice, the vice admiral replied that yes, he would do what he could.
[b]KABOM[/b].
[b]St. Croix has been hit, Commander[/b].
A robotic voice echoed through Dupont's cockpit systems, who slammed his fist on the table saying:
[i]DAMN IT, we have to get out of here soon and meet up with the main fleet.[/i]
He then grabbed a radio and called his subordinates to retreat, then they tried to turn around to escape.
[i]Hehehe, look at that, they're running away...[/i]
[i][b]OH SH-[/b][/i]
The pilot cursed when he saw a Capricorn escort flying to defend the fleet's escape, there were 3, the aircraft flew elegantly through the sky while Harpies chased them like prey in the sky, firing their cannons.
[i]Shootdown successful. Killing successful.[/i]
The two voices echoed through Captain Souto's radio, who, with Soares' prior permission, ordered:
[i]You can return to your escort missions.[/i]
-
[i]They are escaping, but from what Director Reis said...it must be a mere trap to go straight to the main Capricorn fleet, just wasted time.[/i]
Soares said, looking out to sea, as he ordered the ships to cease fire.
------------
Mud, debris, the roar of artillery and mortars and the screams of men. The forest is in chaos, with Bravanor having started the preventive bombing against the Capricorn guerrillas. Smoke and debris fill the scene, with the sounds of Capricorn gunfire mixing with the dull booms of explosions.
Major Vinícius Pereira sneaking through the forest grass was holding only an Imbel RTP sniper rifle in his hands, with Captain Maurício Padilha at his side with the same weapon, they were observing Plairault from afar, their intentions were to cause some damage to the ammunition depots and force the city to surrender.
[i]Sight locked.[/i]
Pereira muttered, Padilha responded. [i]Me too.[/i]
[b]TCHOM[/b]
Their shots were fired, one hit a fuel barrel that exploded part of an ammunition stockpile, the other by the captain hit a Capricorn major in the chest that made him fall to the ground immediately, Marie Fournier who was nearby, was grazed by Maurício, Vinícius reprimanded him.
[i]WE DON'T SHOOT AT IMBECILE CIVILIANS![/i]
[i]But she...[/i]
[i]IT DOESN'T MATTER, DON'T DO IT AGAIN![/i]
Maurício nodded, although still hesitant.
[i]Target eliminated, Major Pierre Beaumanoir.[/i]
The major notified the HQ.

------
[b]Ile de Ré[/b].
May 10th, 8:50AM.
The agents, Camila Ribeiro, Felipe Duarte and Eduarda Silveira infiltrated the rocky island, apparently with nothing, but Reis had given them the mission briefing, which said:
[I]Agents, this mission is important, the Capricorn engineer Etienne Duverger, he is creating a project in collaboration with Minister Fournier to create a ballistic missile called Harpão. If it is ready, it could cause problems, so your mission is to extract or erase this missile, bring me Etienne alive if possible. The moment you read this, the gates and cameras will be deactivated for 1 minute, starting... now.[/i]
That was all the mission briefing said, written all by Reis
[i]Damn...we have to go now.[/i]
Ribeiro said as she read the mission briefing, she quickly grabbed her IMBEL MD 1 SC, and then ordered the other agents:
[i]Let's go.[/i]
They passed through the right side gate, less guarded, two guards who were there were stabbed before the alarm was sounded, and then they stood in front of the entrance of the place.
[i]We have to enter somew-[/i]
[b]Tsssssssssssssssssk[/b]. The entrance opened automatically, without requiring any action from the agents. Director Reis just gave a subtle laugh over the radio and said:
[i]Zahzahsh, you're welcome, now for the mission.[/I]
The corridors of the laboratory were lit by blue LEDs, and the walls were metallic white. On the walls there were computers with data and numbers typed in, and many interconnected rooms. The sound of footsteps could be heard in the corridors. They were laboratory guards. They shouted:
[i]EVACUATE THE SITE, PROTECT THE HARPOON AT ALL COSTS![/i]
There were about 5 guards, and a machine gun mounted further back. They began shooting, tearing apart the corridors. While the agents took cover from the shots, Agent Silveira threw a smoke grenade to prevent the enemy from seeing them properly. Contrary to what she expected, the shots did not stop. Felipe decided to throw a fragmentation grenade, which shattered, hitting 3 soldiers, killing one.
[b]TACTACTACATCATCATCATCATCATCATACTACTACATAC[/b].
The sounds of gunfire echoed, until the Capricorns succumbed, the machine gun was destroyed in the shootout.
Ribeiro passed through a room of monitors, all showing illustrations and details of the missile.
[pre]
Mass: 1300KG.
Multistage warheads.
Cap-03 turbojet engine.
GPS navigation, infrared and Terrain Profile Matching.
Speed: 1500km/h
[b]Warning[/b]: Any attempt at unauthorized access will be recorded and linked to the Lacroix Fall security protocol
[/pre]
Duarte was then called by Ribeiro:

[i]Agent Duarte, send this to Director Reis.[/i]
He nodded and then began to quickly adjust the Harpão Project files and send them to his boss.
[b][i]AAAAAAAAAAGH[/i][/b]
Agent Silveira screamed as she was thrown through the glass of the room. Ribeiro immediately went to her and picked her up, asking how she was and what happened:
[i]Ugh, I'm fine, I just... opened the wrong box.[/i]
She said, composing herself, the red emergency alert light illuminating both of them. When they looked to the side, they saw one of the doors opening and some engineers and technicians running away. Immediately, they both went to the room... Agent Duarte, however, found on the right side, a little hidden, an unlocked door that led him to a narrow, but safe, metal access. [i]Ahh, my God, if you please, spare me, sir![/i]
He fought with one of the scientists on the project, who begged him. Felipe wasn't interested in killing him, but he had a better idea, he took a tactical knife and pressed it against his chin, and then threatened him:
[i]Then give me your hand and I'll let you live.[/i]
The scientist turned pale and was afraid of Felipe, but he didn't want to lose something 
of himself, he finally surrendered, and gave his hand to the Bravanorean brutality, Felipe grabbed him tightly and took the knife, the scientist closed his eyes...
[b][i]AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAGH[/i][/b]
He screamed in pain as a red jet gushed from where his hand was, Duarte pushed him to the ground, and the scientist fled in fear moaning in pain, rolling up the place where his hand was until then making his uniform turn a crimson tone.
[b]Tiiiiiii[/b]. It was the sound of the door opening, she would need the fingerprints of some scientist, but Duarte had already achieved that, two guards surprised by the agent's entrance tried to raise their rifles against him, but Duarte just quickly shot them with his silenced pistol, and reached the central room, or the previous room, Etienne was there analyzing and developing the missile project, now with more pressure from Admiral Bechart and Minister Fournier, he had pale white skin, perhaps because he was more inside his laboratory bunker than in the sunlight, he had messy, slightly wavy and grayish hair along with a dark uniform over another ivory colored one with pants of the same color, when he saw the attack, he tried to grab Felipe to defend himself, but the agent didn't need much. He hit Etienne's arm in defense and when he turned his back to him, Duarte held him back, pointing his Imbel MD 1 at his head. Upon arriving at the command room, there was a large computer in the middle and a launch platform in the middle, along with more monitors with missile data and other computers. The two soldiers in the room aimed at Felipe, who held Volois' body tighter and then said.
[i]If they try to kill me, he'll die with them.[/i]
The threat was strong, and very risky. The soldiers raised their arms. Etienne snorted and ordered one of his soldiers to shoot, but before they could do anything...
[b]TAC TAC.[/b]
The Draco Berserk shots penetrated the metal walls, hitting the soldiers. On the other side, Ribeiro had his infrared vision goggles on and then fired. Although the recoil was massive, it was only two shots. [b]tack, hngh.[/b]
Felipe threw the engineer against the table in front of him and shot him in the leg, leaving him incapacitated, but not dead. Duarte took a pen drive out of his pocket and installed it in the system. This created a virus that destroyed the Harpoon files.
[b]BOOOOOOMBOOOOOOMBOOOOMBOOOOMBOOOOM[/b].
Internal explosions were heard from the internal structure that housed the Harpoon prototype. Finally, Silveira and Ribeiro entered the command room and saw Etienne lying on the floor. Silveira immediately checked his pulse:
[i]He's alive.[/i]
[i]Mission completed, Director Reis. Etienne captured alive and Harpoon destroyed.[/i]
Camila told Reis, who congratulated them and ordered them to return to the mainland and bring Etienne with them.
----------------
A few hours later in St. Louis
[i] BECHART, is Bechart on the line?![/I]
Fournier asked nervously with each word, Bechart answered:
[i]Yes, I am, why...?[/i]
[i]The Harpoon project has been destroyed[/i]!
The Admiral was somewhat shocked, his eyes showed terror, he trembled holding his cell phone.
[i]W...what? Our weapon that should...we should think about surrendering at this point. [/i]
[i]Let's not, we still have a few ships, if...[/i]
[i]Your Excellency, if you'll allow me, there's not much that can be done, since the beginning of the war we've been practically defeated, the destruction of the Harpoon only makes our chances, which are already not very high, become almost zero.[/i]
------------------
May 20, Plairault. [i]Provisional Governor Marie Fournier on the line, who is this?[/i]
Marie spoke into the phone after hearing a call.
